title: pgtools
description: Values of the pgtools chart: the team tools for CloudNativePG, without the operator.

watchNamespaces.description: Namespaces this console watches and gets a Role in. Empty means the release namespace. A short list, never all namespaces.

mcp.description: The MCP endpoint (MCP_ENABLED); writeTools (MCP_WRITE_TOOLS) requires enabled; maxResultBytes, callTimeout, oauthAccessTTL, oauthClientMetadataDocuments and oauthClientMetadataHosts (MCP_MAX_RESULT_BYTES, MCP_CALL_TIMEOUT, MCP_OAUTH_ACCESS_TTL, MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA_DOCUMENTS, MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA_HOSTS) are rendered only with enabled and only when set.

tracing.description: OpenTelemetry tracing over OTLP/HTTP (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, TRACING_*); off while endpoint is empty.

sealKey.description: The drill seal's own keys (RESTORE_DRILL_SEAL_KEY_FILE): an existing Secret of the release namespace and its key, one seal key per line.

operatorKinds.description: Grant read on the pgtoolbox operator's kinds: auto (when the API is served), true or false.

insightPack.description: The insight pack: the ConfigMap <release>-insight-pack of CloudNativePG custom queries, created in each namespace; a Cluster opts in with spec.monitoring.customQueriesConfigMap.

enabled.description: Create the ConfigMap. It changes nothing on a Cluster that does not reference it.

configMapName.description: Name of the pack's ConfigMap, which the console also matches (INSIGHT_PACK_CONFIGMAP). Empty means <release>-insight-pack with the pack enabled, else pgtoolbox-insight-pack.

namespaces.description: Namespaces that get the ConfigMap. Empty means console.watchNamespaces, else the release namespace.

skipNamespaces.description: Namespaces left out, where the team applies the pack's ConfigMap itself: Helm does not take over a ConfigMap it did not create.

evidence.description: Evidence agents without the operator: one per listed Cluster.

cluster.description: The CloudNativePG Cluster in the release namespace.

secrets.description: Every Secret the Cluster's backup configuration names (keys, endpoint CA, region, Azure or GCS credentials): the Role grants get on these only. Empty for workload identity, which reads no Secret.

objectStore.description: The ObjectStore's name, so the Role names it too. Empty: any ObjectStore of the namespace.

stanza.description: pgBackRest through Dalibo's plugin (pgbackrest.dalibo.com): the Stanza the Cluster names (stanzaRef), so the Role names it, and no ObjectStore. Exclusive with archive and objectStore.

archive.description: pgBackRest through Opera's plugin (pgbackrest.cnpg.opera.com): the Archive the Cluster names (pgbackrestObjectName), so the Role names it, and no ObjectStore. Exclusive with stanza and objectStore.

pgbackrest.description: With stanza or archive: which repository the agent reads, the endpoint's CA, and the endpoint pin.

repository.description: The pgBackRest repository number (repo<n>, AGENT_PGBACKREST_REPOSITORY). Dalibo's plugin numbers its S3 repositories first, then its Azure ones. Unset: 1.

endpointCA.description: The CA of the repository's endpoint, a key of a Secret that secrets lists; it wins over the CA the plugin's object names. TLS is always verified.

endpoint.description: The endpoint pin (AGENT_PGBACKREST_ENDPOINT): a host[:port] the repository's endpoint must be, the S3 endpoint the plugin's object names or the Azure account's Blob host; any other is refused. It also admits an Azure storage key or SAS token sent outside the Azure Blob domains (Azurite).

allowInsecureEndpoint.description: Admit a plain-http object-store endpoint (AGENT_ALLOW_INSECURE_ENDPOINT), over which the credentials cross the network in clear text. Off, the agent refuses such an endpoint by name.

workloadIdentity.description: Opt in to the Pod's cloud identity (AGENT_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY): without this block a configuration using inheritFromIAMRole, inheritFromAzureAD, useDefaultAzureCredentials or gkeEnvironment is refused, so the agent never falls back to the node's identity. {} is enough for GKE workload identity federation.

platform.description: Where the identity comes from, for evidence.networkPolicy: gke (the GKE metadata server, 169.254.169.254:80 and 169.254.169.252:988), eksPodIdentity (the EKS Pod Identity Agent, 169.254.170.23:80 and [fd00:ec2::23]:80), irsa or azure (token exchange over HTTPS: allow it through evidence.networkPolicy.objectStore). Empty: no link-local egress is opened.

serviceAccountAnnotations.description: Workload-identity annotations on the agent's ServiceAccount, and only these.

podLabels.description: Labels on the agent's Pod: azure.workload.identity/use only (quote "true").

pgadmin.description: pgAdmin without the operator: off by default.

caSecret.description: Secret holding the Cluster's server CA (ca.crt). Without it or caConfigMap: the derived <cluster>-ca, deprecated.

caConfigMap.description: ConfigMap holding only the Cluster's server CA (ca.crt), mounted into the sidecar: the Role then names no CA Secret.

credentials.description: Where the credential comes from; required, there is no default.
